source: ClassPad.net Math — exact fx-880BTG PLUS, observed 2026-11-19 through visible keys and LCD SVG; saved directly to project. Manual limits are expectations, separate from observations.
notes: 47 accepted full LCD and status samples, captured from exact PLUS via visible keys. Saved directly to project.
Both Sigma and Product reject an endpoint at -1e10; Sigma also rejects +1e10. Endpoint 9999999999 is valid for Sigma; Product at -9999999999 is valid. Fractional bounds are Argument ERROR.
Sigma rejects intermediate overflow even when later terms cancel. In Degree, Sigma(9e99*cos(60*x),-1,4) gives Math ERROR. Product(0.1,1,100)*1e99 and Sigma(1e-100,1,10)*1e99 both give 0.
Independent holdouts: Sigma(1e-100*1e99,1,10) and Product(1e-100*1e99,1,1) both give 0. Underflow is applied inside each term and exact evaluation must not restore it.

LineI errors return to closing parenthesis. MathI invalid bounds return to upper bound; MathI domain errors in 1/x at zero return to end of body. Correcting Product upper bound 1 to 3 with lower 3 yields 3.

Fractional script limits require native small decimal point and centering. Existing default calculus and all 580 regressions are checked separately. Long iteration limits and arbitrary nested functions remain outside this observation set.
